# PROJECT BRIEF — Vision, Goal, and Captured Plans

> This is the durable record of **what we are building and why**, so no step is
> taken blindly. It captures the user's own words/plans. Secrets are NOT stored
> here (see `.env.example` / `config.py`).

## ⭐ PRIME DIRECTIVE — the WHY (added 2026-07-04)
**This project exists to generate consistent, risk-managed income for its owner — a real,
repeatable living, not a lottery.** Every capability below is a means to that end. Honest truth:
no system guarantees profit; the path to income is *protect capital, take small risk-managed
edges, and compound.* **Dual-mode risk:** **PAPER** = unlimited-risk learning lab (blowups are
training data, no caps — discover what makes money); **LIVE / real money** = capital-preservation
FIRST, balanced risk, all guardrails enforced, never blow up — reached only after a strategy proves
consistent profitability on paper. Full statement + the `/money-lens` decision rule live in the
`/goal` skill; run `/money-lens` before any money/risk/build decision.

## The Goal (one paragraph)
Build a **CPU-first "network of prediction models with a brain"**: hundreds of
ML/DL/quant models wired as **graph "nodes"** (each a full model with its own
golden dataset), trained supervised-style — known input→output first to raise
accuracy, then predicting unknown outputs. An outside **"brain" agent** has
access to all nodes and the full data flow, **reads books/PDFs/news into
memory**, learns, grows, and learns *how to wire/route the nodes*. Primary domain
is trading/quant, but nodes generalize to any data. Reuse mature open-source
first; invent only where nothing exists. GPU is off for now, switchable later.

## Scope of "nodes" / domains
Advanced ML models, deep learning, transformers, AI agents, ML algorithms;
mathematics, physics, quantum finance, quantitative methods; probability,
statistics; **noise finding, chaos finding, finding patterns in chaos/noise,
learning patterns, and prediction**. PhD-level concepts welcomed.

## Hard constraints / preferences
- **CPU-only first**, GPU path deferred and flag-switchable.
- **Reuse-first (search-copy-adapt-stitch)**: for any new code, FIRST search online/GitHub
  for working code; copy & adapt it to our interface, and stitch multiple OSS projects/
  snippets together. Build from scratch ONLY when no similar code exists anywhere.
- **Self-documenting + indexed + interface-enforced** codebase (see `CONVENTIONS.md`).
- **Dashboard-sync**: every node/feature/intelligence capability appears on an
  ultra-visual animated dashboard (**React + D3/Three.js**), auto-reflecting new additions.

# Project North-Star Goal

Print the PRIME DIRECTIVE first, then the full goal statement below, then briefly
confirm which pillars are already built vs. still pending based on the current codebase state.

---

## ⭐ PRIME DIRECTIVE — WHY THIS PROJECT EXISTS (read before every decision)

**This project exists for ONE reason: to generate consistent, risk-managed income for its
owner — a real, repeatable living, NOT a lottery or a gamble.** Every pillar, every node,
every line of code, and every decision below is a means to that end. If a step does not move
*real, repeatable income* forward — directly, or by learning what will — it is not worth taking.

**The honest truth (never hidden from the owner):** no system — including this one — can
*promise* profit. Markets are uncertain. The only sound path to income is **protect the capital,
take small risk-managed edges, and compound.** A strategy reaches real money ONLY after it proves
consistent, cost- and overfit-adjusted profitability on paper first.

**DUAL-MODE RISK — the core operating rule:**

| Mode | Purpose | Risk policy |
|---|---|---|
| **PAPER (LEARN)** | Discover what actually makes money | **Unlimited risk. Blowups are allowed and expected — they are training data.** No capital caps; sizing / anti-overfit gates may be relaxed to explore freely. Every wipeout is logged and learned from. This is the lab. |
| **LIVE / REAL MONEY (EARN)** | Turn proven edges into steady income | **Capital preservation FIRST.** Balanced risk for steadier income. ALL guardrails strictly enforced: knowledge-first sizing (Pillar 4), no full-capital trades (Pillar 12-E), anti-overfit promotion gate (Pillar 20), portfolio/regime risk caps (Pillar 22), calibrated abstention (Pillar 17). Never blow up. |

- **Default mode is PAPER.** Switching to live real money is an explicit, deliberate, auditable act — never automatic.
- **Promotion gate (paper → live):** a strategy may trade real money only after proving consistent profitability on paper *net of costs (Pillar 21)* and *after overfit deflation (Pillar 20)* over a meaningful window.
- **The decision lens (`/money-lens`):** every proposed step is judged mode-aware — on paper, *"does this help us learn what makes money?"* (risk allowed); on live, *"does this protect capital AND move toward steady income?"* (block if not).

> In short: **all 26 pillars below are the HOW. Consistent, risk-managed income is the WHY.**

---
